/obs scene set "fallback-encoder"
# mic toggle: amixer -q set Capture cap

Priya: Will monitor thread and flag any employee questions to leadership. :white_check_mark:

Ben: If any visuals fail, fallback plan is to put the slide deck link in chat + do a verbal summary.
Elena: Noted. After the meeting I'll drop the roadmap note and ping infra.
Carlos: Thanks everyone — will follow up with Liam and post the validation summary.
Maya: Thanks team — appreciated the quick pivot. Ending thread here.
